mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id AS cartId, c.quantity AS quantity, c.user_id AS userId, c.product_id AS productId, c.option_id AS optionId, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, i.image_id AS imageId FROM CART c INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.product_id = i.product_id AND i.is_main = 'Y' WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.cart_type = #{cartType} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
